_note: Godot-only balance overlay (docs/DAMAGE.md 'Balance and cooldowns'). Merged over weapons.json by MatchSim and used only while Combat.tuning_active() (offline, or online with net_zones), so the JS parity tests and web peers keep the shared numbers. Optional fields: burst {n, regen} = n shots, then one charge back every regen s; swapCd = draw time after equipping.
